summary.headline: Signs and Planetary Climates
summary.text: Signs and their triplicities are assigned to the east, south, west, and north according to their natures and angular relationships; the earth is further divided into seven planetary climates, from Saturn through the Moon, with corresponding lands, cities, and terms.
